basic_info.description: Designed for comfort, style and entertaining, this updated and remodeled home features dramatic soaring ceilings, expansive floor to ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light, and an open, airy layout that allows for convenient living. Spread across three thoughtfully designed levels, this  2-bedroom/2 bath condominium offers ideal separation of space with an open upper level ensuite bedroom and an additional private primary suite below. The contemporary kitchen and updated baths have been tastefully remodeled to complement the home's sleek, architectural feel. And when it's time to unwind, head up to the beautiful shared roof deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining with sweeping views. Enjoy the convenience of a garage with parking, storage and interior access. This elevator building offers it all in one of San Francisco's sunniest neighborhoods.      This unique loft blends urban sophistication with everyday practicality in a vibrant and walkable neighborhood surrounded by charming parks, local cafes, and a solid lineup of restaurants. Plus, you're just minutes from public transit, and the freeway so getting around the city is a breeze.  A must-see for anyone seeking style, space, and sunlight in the city.
